text: Rail and Infrastructure Industry Week opens

Vietnam's Rail and Infrastructure Industry Week - Rails & Cons 2026 - officially opened on November 11, bringing together industry professionals, businesses and technology providers to discuss the future of the country's railway and infrastructure sectors.

Through a series of conferences, technical presentations and exhibitions, Rails & Cons 2026 focuses on key issues including high-speed railway development strategies, transit-oriented development (TOD), construction technologies, digital transformation, workforce development and the localisation of railway-related industries.
Alongside the conference program, exhibitions showcase products, equipment and technological solutions for railway systems, construction and infrastructure development.

A business-to-business (B2B) networking program scheduled for November 13 will provide opportunities for companies to meet potential partners, discuss business needs, explore cooperation opportunities and seek participation in the supply chains of major infrastructure projects.
The event aims to facilitate knowledge exchange and strengthen connections among industry stakeholders as Vietnam advances its railway and infrastructure development plans.
